title: SharedSecret leaked to browser via QuickSignInDialog JS interop
rationale: The spec explicitly says to reuse wwwroot/dev-quick-signin.js in QuickSignInDialog, which is what the existing Login.razor already does. The secret is validated to only be non-empty in Development/Test environments (AppAuthenticationOptionsValidator enforces this), so the secret never lands in a prod bundle. Fixing this would require a new browser-originated endpoint (a scope-creep change beyond what the spec authorized). Recommended as a Session 2 or future follow-up along with the explicitly-deferred items (env badge, persona sourcing, keyboard shortcut).

title: TestAuthClient conditional registration could fail DI if dialogs resolved before gate
fix: Registered TestAuthClient unconditionally in Program.cs. The gate is still enforced by DevToolsMenu reading AuthOptions.Value.SeededSession.Enabled; TestAuthClient.IsEnabled mirrors the same flag.

title: DevEmailInbox registration lifetime unverified
rationale: Confirmed DevEmailInbox is TryAddSingleton in Dabbler.Security.Extensions.ServiceCollectionExtensions.cs:133, so the dialog's TestAuthClient and the /test-auth/magic-links endpoint share the same instance.

title: DevToolsMenu tests don't verify clicking a menu item opens its dialog
rationale: MudMenu renders items inside a popover that JS interop materializes on click. bUnit's Loose JS mode cannot expand it, and MudBlazor does not render the items into the markup until open. Added a comment in DevToolsMenuTests noting the gap; the click-opens-dialog behavior is covered by the Session 2 Playwright smoke test and by MagicLinksDialogTests which instantiates the dialog directly via IDialogService.

title: Hardcoded persona list
rationale: Spec explicitly defers 'persona sourcing from security-config.json' to future work.

title: Integration tests hardcode the shared secret
fix: DevToolsEndpointContractTests now resolves the secret via IOptions<AppAuthenticationOptions> so the tests track appsettings changes.

title: TestAuthClient duplicates endpoint session-info logic
fix: Added a cross-reference comment in TestAuthClient.GetSessionInfoAsync pointing to the endpoint in Program.cs and the contract test.

title: Dialog filter uses Contains while endpoint uses Equals
fix: Added a comment in MagicLinksDialog explaining the intentional difference (substring match is better UX).
